rows.grounds: tat = that; accusative neuter singular of tad, object of pracodayāt
naḥ = us; 1st person plural dative (genitive/accusative also possible), here 'for us' with pracodayāt
viṣṇuḥ = viṣṇu; nominative singular masculine subject
pracodayāt = may-inspire; 3rd singular optative active of √pracud
